items.mainDefect: The `queued` default `timezone.now()` runs once at module import, so every AssignmentSource created without an explicit value gets the same stale timestamp.

secondary.defect: test_to_dict only checks that `queued` is not None, which hides the wrong timestamp.

items.mainDefect: The test only checks that `queued` is not None, so it passes no matter what value the field holds and cannot catch a wrong timestamp.

secondary.defect: The `queued` default `timezone.now()` runs once at class definition, so all instances share the process start time; it should use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)`.

items.mainDefect: test_from_dict_empty_array passes `{}` instead of an array, so the name is wrong and non-dict input such as a list is never tested.
